items.program_name: Michigan Business Development Program(Performance Based Grant)
items.summary: Michigan Strategic FundがMBDP(Michigan Business Development Program)のパフォーマンス型助成として、Pontiac拠点のLHP Engineering Servicesに最大$500kを承認。予定投資額は$3.6M、新規雇用35人。
items.infer: LHP Engineering Servicesはエンジニアリング・製造技術サービス企業であり、投資は生産・試験設備の拡充に使われる可能性(推論)。設備投資に伴い加工機・検査装置の需要が生じる可能性(推論)。
items.verbatim: Michigan Strategic Fund approved a Michigan Business Development Program Performance Based Grant on 2024-02-13. Location: Pontiac. Projected investment: Up to $3.60 million. Projected jobs: 35. Projected award: Up to $500,000.
